annotation.title_clean: ISO/AWI 25927 Ships and marine technology — Guideline for test scenario generation process for collision avoidance for MASS
annotation.title_en: ISO/AWI 25927 Ships and marine technology — Guideline for test scenario generation process for collision avoidance for MASS
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO/AWI 25927, a standard under development (approved work item) by ISO/TC 8/SC 26. It specifies a process for generating collision-avoidance test scenarios for Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships, in simulation and real-ship tests, based on COLREGs encounter situations and the ODD.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines a general process, core elements and evaluation indicators for MASS collision avoidance test scenario generation
Applies to simulation and real-ship tests in open and restricted waters
Covers COLREGs encounter situations: head-on, crossing, overtaking
Scenario elements are derived from the MASS Operational Design Domain, referring to CCS Rules
Does not specify performance indicators or individual sensor parameters
